page.overview:
What is The Ecstasy of Gold?

"The Ecstasy of Gold" is an instrumental originally written by Ennio Morricone. A section of it is often used as an intro to Metallica concerts, and Metallica even recorded a version of it for an Ennio Morricone tribute album.
